reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole, clarithromycin, erythromycin, ritonavir, cobicistat)
key_interactions.effect: Higher corticosteroid levels and systemic side effects (label).
key_interactions.action: Weigh benefit and risk; monitor for corticosteroid side effects.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 inducers (barbiturates, phenytoin, carbamazepine, rifampin, ephedrine)
key_interactions.action: The corticosteroid dose may need to be increased.

key_interactions.effect: Higher activity of both; convulsions reported (label).
